# Bells Fork Truck & Auto

> Used car, truck, and diesel vehicle dealership in Greenville, NC.

## About
Bells Fork Truck & Auto is a pre-owned vehicle dealership located at 3840 Charles Blvd, Greenville, NC 27858. We specialize in quality used cars, trucks, SUVs, and diesel vehicles. Every vehicle undergoes a multi-point mechanical inspection before listing. We serve Greenville, Winterville, Farmville, Ayden, Simpson, Bethel, and the greater Eastern North Carolina region.

## Inventory
We carry pre-owned vehicles including:
- Trucks: Ford F-150, RAM 1500, RAM 2500, Chevrolet Silverado, Toyota Tacoma, Toyota Tundra, GMC Sierra
- SUVs: Chevrolet Tahoe, GMC Yukon, Jeep Wrangler, Ford Bronco Sport, Toyota RAV4
- Cars: Chevrolet Camaro, Chevrolet Corvette, Dodge Challenger, Subaru WRX
- Diesel: RAM 2500 Cummins, Ford F-250 Power Stroke, Chevrolet Duramax

Vehicles typically range from $11,995 to $60,000. Current inventory includes approximately 34 vehicles.

## Why Choose Bells Fork
- Every vehicle is inspected by certified technicians before listing
- Transparent, market-based pricing with no hidden fees or last-minute add-ons
- Financing available for all credit situations
- Trade-in appraisals offered on all purchases
- Locally owned dealership serving Eastern North Carolina
- Walk-ins welcome; test drives available by appointment or on the spot

- Vehicle sales (pre-owned cars, trucks, SUVs, diesel)
- Financing applications (online and in-person)
- Trade-in valuations
- Test drive scheduling

- Pre-qualification (no SSN required, no credit score impact options)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What types of vehicles does Bells Fork Truck & Auto sell?
A: We sell quality pre-owned cars, trucks, SUVs, crossovers, and diesel vehicles from brands including Ford, Chevrolet, RAM, GMC, Toyota, Jeep, and more.

Q: Are the vehicles inspected?
A: Yes. Every vehicle undergoes a multi-point mechanical inspection before being listed for sale.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We work with multiple lenders and accept buyers in every credit situation. You can apply online or in person.

Q: Do you accept trade-ins?
A: Yes. We offer fair market trade-in appraisals. Submit a request online or bring your vehicle to the lot.

Q: Where is Bells Fork Truck & Auto located?
A: 3840 Charles Blvd, Greenville, NC 27858. We serve Greenville, Winterville, Ayden, Farmville, Washington, New Bern, Kinston, Jacksonville, Rocky Mount, and Wilson.

Q: What are your business hours?
A: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Sunday by appointment only.
